summary: Complete backend testing of Self-Service Candidate Onboarding Module. All 14 onboarding endpoints tested successfully with 30/30 tests passing. The full E2E workflow (invite -> candidate fills form -> uploads documents -> submits -> HR assigns/verifies -> complete -> Employee ID generated) is working correctly.
endpoints_tested: POST /api/onboarding/invite - HR sends invite to candidate

workflow_validation.invite_flow: WORKING - Creates submission with token, sends email
workflow_validation.candidate_flow: WORKING - Public access, save progress, upload docs, submit
workflow_validation.hr_review_flow: WORKING - Assign details, verify docs/bank, request revision, reject
workflow_validation.completion_flow: WORKING - Generates DVBC format Employee ID, creates employee record
workflow_validation.validation_rules: WORKING - Requires 2+ documents, all HR verifications before complete

observations: Router properly registered in server.py at line 249 and 270
Token-based public access implemented securely using secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
Token expiry set to 7 days with proper validation
Employee ID generation follows DVBC format (DVBC001, DVBC002, etc.)
Proper role-based access control (hr_manager, hr_executive, admin)
Complete validation before employee creation (docs, bank, HR fields)
Audit log maintained for all actions
File upload restricted to PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP with 5MB limit

seed_data_creation: Test created multiple submissions during testing with unique emails/PAN numbers
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 onboarding endpoints fully tested and working. The complete E2E flow from invite to employee creation (with DVBC format Employee ID) is verified. Key requirement: at least 2 documents must be uploaded, and both document and bank verification must be completed before onboarding can be finalized. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding_self_service.py covers all endpoints with 30 test cases.
